provenance.purpose: Deterministic, network-free production replay of the deployed Waltham Cross evidence used to validate the Alpha.15 PlannerServiceGroup abstraction.
provenance.extractionMethod: Fetched the deployed Pages manifest, selected the authoritative prepared NaPTAN shard(s) for the confirmed Waltham Cross point and 700 m radius, then selected every raw prepared timetable record with scheduled evidence at an in-scope stop for the declared route scope. Stop rows and service records are retained without manual route/operator/terminus cleanup; distances are the deterministic assessment calculation.
